content: {"paper_id":"W4414888044","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Classifier enhancement based on credible sample selection for partial multi-label learning","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确面向部分多标记学习，属于弱监督多标记分类/识别任务。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Partial multi-label learning (PML) is a weakly supervised framework where each training sample is associated with several candidate labels, which include noisy labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要定义PML为弱监督框架，监督信号为含噪候选标签集，属于不精确/不完整的弱监督。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"each training sample is associated with several candidate labels, which include noisy labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"训练监督明确包含噪声标签，且摘要以克服噪声干扰为研究目标。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"pseudo-labels are introduced and integrated into the model training.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"伪标签被引入并整合进模型训练，作为后续训练信号。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"the manifold structure reinforces the instance-level consistency between features and labels within the subset space.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"利用流形结构约束子空间内特征与标签的实例级一致性，符合图/流形正则化。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","reason_zh":"摘要虽提及候选标签集合，但标题与摘要为partial multi-label且未说明标准偏标记仅一个真实标记，无法按partial-label定义确认。"}],"input_issues":[]}
